sections.heading: We measure the room before we build a thing.
sections.body:
A creative space rarely matches a catalogue. Offices, craft rooms and home bars each store something different, and the room itself has odd heights, angled ceilings and a door that cannot move.

So a designer measures the space, talks through what lives there, and every shelf is cut to that one room in our own shop. One trade, done well, fitted in a single visit without tearing out what you already have.

items.question: Do you have to replace my cabinets?
items.answer: No. The shelves and racks fit inside the cabinets you already have. We build around them, not instead of them.

items.question: Can you build for a room that does not fit a category?
items.answer: Yes — that is exactly what custom layouts are for. We measure the space, talk through what lives there, and build to it.

items.question: How much weight will a shelf hold?
items.answer: Standard glides are rated to **100 lb**, and we spec weight-rated runners for a full case of wine or a loaded craft drawer.

items.question: How long does a room take to install?
items.answer: Most rooms are done in a single visit. Larger builds across several areas can run to a full day, and we tell you which before you book.

items.question: What is the warranty?
items.answer: Lifetime on the glide hardware for as long as you own the home. Shelves themselves carry a five year warranty against defects.
